---
title: "Calendar on Omarchy"
status: mature
---

A clickable YAD calendar for Waybar, with optional Hyprland keybinding and window rules.

## install YAD

```bash
sudo pacman -Syu
sudo pacman -S yad
```

## create the calendar script

Create:

```text
~/.config/waybar/scripts/calendar.sh
```

Minimal version:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

yad --calendar
```

Make it executable:

```bash
chmod +x ~/.config/waybar/scripts/calendar.sh
```

## add it to Waybar

In `~/.config/waybar/config.jsonc`:

```json
"custom/calendar": {
  "format": "",
  "tooltip": false,
  "on-click": "~/.config/waybar/scripts/calendar.sh"
}
```

Add `"custom/calendar"` to `modules-right`, for example:

```json
"modules-right": [
  "group/tray-expander",
  "custom/calendar",
  "bluetooth",
  "network",
  "pulseaudio",
  "cpu",
  "battery"
]
```

In `~/.config/waybar/styles.css`:

```css
#custom-calendar {
  min-width: 12px;
  margin: 0 18px;
}
```

Reload Waybar:

```bash
pkill waybar && waybar &
```

## optional: keyboard shortcut

For `SUPER + C`, add to `~/.config/hypr/bindings.conf`:

```ini
bindd = SUPER, C, Calendar, exec, ~/.config/waybar/scripts/calendar.sh
```

## optional: toggle behavior

To make repeated clicks close an existing calendar instead of opening another one:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

if pgrep -f 'yad --calendar --title=Calendar' >/dev/null; then
  pkill -f 'yad --calendar --title=Calendar'
  exit 0
fi

yad --calendar \
  --title="Calendar" \
  --width=320 \
  --height=260 \
  --no-buttons
```

## optional: float and center it

Add to `~/.config/hypr/hyprland.conf`:

```ini
windowrulev2 = float, class:^(?i:yad)$, title:^(Calendar)$
windowrulev2 = center, class:^(?i:yad)$, title:^(Calendar)$
```
